notes: The opening «ما كان فيه عن أبي الأعز النخاس» names the source of the content; the first route does not write him after Safwan, so he is not added to it, and the second route, which writes him, ends at him
«- رضي اللّه عنه -» is a blessing, left out; «أبي» is a bare relation to the compiler
The two routes are separated by «؛» and the second begins with «و محمد بن أبي عمير» (rule 4: a second isnad for the same content, so a second group)
